title: Compass and Wreck
author: Rafael Galloway
blurb: Cyrus Quintana, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
